comparison.objective: Close only the cabinet doors that begin open without toggling closed doors open.
comparison.physical_skill: State recognition and selective push-latch actuation.
comparison.success_condition: All initially open doors latched; actuating any initially closed door forces zero. Exact travel/force thresholds are absent from the body.
comparison.reason: Selective toggle actuation is unrelated to tool alignment, impact dynamics, fracture, retained-component protection, and debris recovery.
